summary: A highly dedicated and accomplished human resources manager with a record of proficiency in employee relations, training and development programs, recruitment and onboarding, payroll management, benefits administration, HRMS database administration, job description development, wage/salary reviews, record keeping, and compliance. Proven leader in championing company values, vision, and expectations through effective communication and facilitation. Aligns HR strategy with business objectives, assesses and anticipates HR-related needs, communicates proactively within global HR teams and management, and seeks to develop highly effective integrated HR solutions.

responsibilities: Aligned HR strategy with business objectives and communicated proactively within global HR teams.
Managed full-cycle bi-weekly payroll, policy creation, training programs, employee handbook, and compliance training.
Oversaw benefits renewal, open enrollment, and negotiated with insurance brokers to achieve cost savings.
Provided workforce planning, succession planning, compensation benchmarking, and talent development.
Facilitated relocation support, visa processes, and cost-effective relocation management.
Earned 2013 individual award for global excellence.

experience.title: HR Manager

Developed employee handbook, safety/compliance training, and orientation programs.

responsibilities: Transferred from PEO to full-service payroll and benefits setup across 15 states and five localities.
Implemented FSA and commuter benefits, background check, and drug testing processes.
Managed payroll transition and ensured compliance with regulatory mandates.
Provided guidance on workforce planning, succession, and compensation.

Coordinated OSHA safety training and tracked attendance.
Supervised recruitment, orientation, and performance reviews of service staff.
